product_one_liner.value: Fly.io provides developers and AI-agent builders with a global public cloud of hardware-isolated Linux VMs for deploying and running applications and agents close to users.

named_customers.notes: Fly.io says these agent-first companies use its platform.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 56 employees, which falls in the 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists Chicago as headquarters; some third-party company profiles list San Francisco.

founded_year.notes: Fly.io's About page says it has been building since 2017; some third-party profiles differ on the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical build-focused posts, including engineering deep dives on macaroons and user-mode WireGuard.

public_docs.notes: The public developer docs include guides and reference documentation for multiple products and platform areas.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled “AI-Native Detection and Triage Engineer”; a listing updated November 5, 2026 supports availability before the November 9 reference date.

model_provider.value: OpenRouter (through a Connector using the customer’s own key)
model_provider.notes: Fly.io documents OpenRouter for model access, but the customer supplies the key; this is not a statement that Fly.io uses a built-in model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names SOC 2 Type 2 and a HIPAA BAA.

raised_18mo.notes: The $25 million Series D was announced July 24, 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current Fly.io jobs index lists engineering and account-manager roles, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Fly.io announced a new unified Fly MCP server on October 23, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Fly.io announced that Scott Johnston joined as CEO on July 24, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Fly.io lists HubSpot for CRM and Customer.io for newsletters and transactional email.
